decisions.reason: The flagship citrus crate is absent from the website in 2020 and 2021, which raises doubt, but its strategic sustainability role and the firm's slack argue for carrying it while agricultural results mature.
A multi-model foldable large container line fits the core returnable-packaging business, so its absence from the site more likely reflects a website restructuring than a shortfall against aspiration.
Stackable crates are standard core products with broad food and retail demand, so dropping them would release few resources and gain little.
The rackable pallet line complements the pallet portfolio at low incremental cost, and no clear shortfall justifies problemistic search.
The spill-retention pallet is an industrial niche line whose visibility has faded, but slack lets the firm keep it while it judges demand.
A single-model niche pallet that has not been visible for two years likely falls below aspiration, and its resources are better redirected to core lines.
